collection_notes: Input JSON was collapsed once per runtime with the observed root expanded-icon control; no application parameter changes or server reruns were requested.

A preliminary Python badge hover was observed and dismissed before the retained initial state. The seven retained help observations use actual CDP Input.dispatchMouseEvent mouseMoved input at fresh DOM-derived target coordinates and wait for visible tooltip names.
Hidden zero-size measurement copies of badges are retained in elements.badges; visible_badges separately records only positive-size visible spans. The empty badge has no visible span.

The directive-like label renders as x] [other in both runtimes, with zero-size nested badge copies in the DOM. Existing backslash labels use an adjacent Help button. These reference behaviors are retained, not presented as a general escaping or security guarantee.

Four screenshot requests timed out before returning image bytes: Python initial, Python Markdown-help, Rust Markdown-help, Python subheader-help. Saved files were inspected; only missing screenshots were retried, without replaying collapse/hover. The last recovery explicitly activated the owned tabs with Page.bringToFront before capture.
This is initial-render tooltip validation; it does not repair or prove dynamic help identity updates.
